name: Product & Category Slider for WooCommerce – Amitry
author: amitry

sections.description:
Product & Category Slider for WooCommerce – Amitry is a fast, responsive WooCommerce slider plugin for products and product categories. Create a product slider, product carousel or category carousel in minutes with the Gutenberg block, the Elementor widget or the [amitry_slider] shortcode.

Use it to highlight featured products, show new arrivals, promote sale products, display best sellers or guide shoppers into your WooCommerce product categories. The slider is lightweight, mobile-friendly and built to load only on pages where it is actually used.

View the live demo

Why choose this WooCommerce slider?

  • Product slider and category slider in one plugin – showcase WooCommerce products or product categories.
  • No code required – add sliders with a Gutenberg block, Elementor widget or shortcode.
  • Responsive by default – set separate columns for desktop, tablet and mobile.
  • Lightweight and fast – CSS and JavaScript load only when a slider is rendered.
  • SEO-friendly output – server-side rendered HTML keeps slider content visible without JavaScript.
  • Flexible styling – adjust card style, image shape, spacing, radius, shadows, colors and hover effects.
  • Theme-friendly – works with classic themes and modern block themes.
  • Translation-ready – includes a .pot file for localization.

Add sliders your way

  • Gutenberg block – insert the Amitry Slider block into any page or post and preview changes live in the editor.
  • Elementor widget – use the dedicated Amitry Slider widget when Elementor is active.
  • Shortcode – place [amitry_slider] anywhere shortcodes are supported.

Popular use cases

  • Homepage product slider – feature selected WooCommerce products on your homepage.
  • New arrivals carousel – automatically show your newest products.
  • Best sellers slider – highlight popular products from your store.
  • Sale products slider – promote discounted products and deals.
  • Featured products showcase – display a hand-picked product selection.
  • Product category carousel – help shoppers browse your store by category.
  • Related products slider – keep visitors shopping on single product pages.
  • Landing page carousel – add a focused product carousel to campaigns and sales pages.

Product slider features

Choose which WooCommerce products to show:

  • Newest products
  • Best selling products
  • On-sale products
  • Featured products
  • Top rated products
  • Manually selected products
  • Products from a selected category

Control what appears on each product card:

  • Product image
  • Product title
  • Price with sale strike-through
  • Sale badge
  • Rating stars
  • Short description
  • Stock status
  • Add-to-cart button

Category slider features

Create a WooCommerce category carousel with:

  • All product categories or selected categories
  • Optional category exclude list
  • Sorting by name, product count or menu order
  • Option to hide empty categories
  • Fallback to the first product image when a category has no thumbnail
  • Optional product count per category

Layout and design options

  • Two free card styles: Clean Card and Minimal
  • Rounded, square or circle image shapes
  • Adjustable columns per device
  • Adjustable gaps, card padding, border radius and shadow
  • Hover effects: lift, zoom, lift + zoom and shine
  • Navigation arrows, dots, scrollbar, progress bar and slide counter
  • Keyboard control
  • Autoplay with delay, loop and pause-on-hover options

Block editor integration

The Gutenberg block includes a clean two-panel sidebar:

  • Settings – choose the slider type, product source, layout, behavior and navigation.
  • Styles – customize card style, colors, shadows, image shape and hover effects.

The block uses server-side rendering, so the editor preview closely matches the frontend output.

Shortcode examples

[amitry_slider type="products" filter="newest" count="12"]
[amitry_slider type="products" filter="sale" slides_desktop="4"]
[amitry_slider type="products" filter="featured" count="8"]
[amitry_slider type="categories" sort="count"]

All block options are also available as shortcode attributes.

Performance and accessibility

Product & Category Slider for WooCommerce – Amitry is built to stay lightweight:

  • CSS and JavaScript load only on pages where a slider is rendered.
  • Swiper is bundled locally, so no external CDN request is needed.
  • Optional query caching can reduce repeated product and category queries.
  • The slider respects the system prefers-reduced-motion setting.
  • When reduced motion is enabled, autoplay is disabled, slide transitions are instant and hover motion is removed.

WooCommerce compatibility

  • Requires WooCommerce.
  • Compatible with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).
  • Compatible with WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • Works with classic themes and block themes.
  • Works with the latest supported WordPress and WooCommerce versions.

Free plugin and Pro add-on

The free plugin works fully on its own and includes the core product slider, category slider, Gutenberg block, Elementor widget, shortcode, responsive controls and styling options.

A separate Pro add-on extends the free plugin through documented hooks and adds advanced shop features, including:

  • Premium designs: Overlay, Circle, 3D Carousel and Masonry
  • Hover image swap
  • Automatic New and Bestseller badges
  • AJAX add to cart
  • Quick View popup
  • Sale countdown timer
  • Wishlist with a dedicated wishlist page
  • Stock progress bar
  • Low-stock label

View the live demo

Get the Pro add-on
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  4. Add the Amitry Slider block to a page, use the Elementor widget or place the [amitry_slider] shortcode in your content.
  5. Optional: set global defaults under Settings -> Amitry Slider.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is required because the plugin reads WooCommerce products and product categories.

How do I add a WooCommerce product slider without code?

Add the Amitry Slider block in the block editor and choose Products as the slider type. You can also use the Elementor widget or paste the [amitry_slider type="products"] shortcode into your content.

Can I show product categories as a carousel?

Yes. Set the slider type to Categories to create a WooCommerce category carousel with images, category names and optional product counts.

Can I create a featured products slider?

Yes. Choose Featured as the product source to build a featured products slider. You can also display newest products, best sellers, sale products, top rated products, manually selected products or products from a specific category.

Can I show products from a specific category?

Yes. Select a product category as the product source, or use the category slider to display product categories as a carousel.

Does the plugin work with Elementor?

Yes. When Elementor is active, a dedicated Amitry Slider widget is available in the Elementor editor.

Does the plugin work with block themes and Full Site Editing?

Yes. The block uses server-side rendering and works with both classic themes and block themes.

Is the plugin compatible with HPOS?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage. It does not read or write WooCommerce orders.

Will the slider slow down my site?

The plugin is built to be lightweight. Slider CSS and JavaScript load only on pages where a slider is used, and Swiper is bundled locally instead of loaded from an external CDN.

Is the slider responsive on mobile?

Yes. You can set different slides-per-view values for desktop, tablet and mobile.

Does the slider support autoplay and infinite loop?

Yes. You can enable autoplay, set the delay, pause autoplay on hover and use looping.

Can I customize the slider design and colors?

Yes. You can customize the card style, image shape, columns, spacing, shadows, hover effects, title colors, price colors and button colors.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes. The plugin uses standard WordPress internationalization and includes a .pot file in /languages/.

Is there a live demo?

Yes. You can view the product slider, category carousel and premium designs on the live demo.

What does the Pro add-on add?

The Pro add-on adds premium designs and advanced shop features such as Quick View, AJAX add to cart, wishlist, countdown timer, hover image swap, extra badges, stock progress bar and low-stock label.
sections.changelog:
4.0.5

  • Improved: The slider now respects the system “reduced motion” setting. When enabled, autoplay is disabled, slide transitions are instant and hover motion is removed.
  • Improved: Nicer category multi-select in the block editor with roomier rows, hover state, selected highlight and softer scrollbar.

4.0.3

  • Improved: Expanded documentation with popular use cases and additional FAQs.
  • Added: Link to the live demo.

4.0.2

  • New: Lift + Zoom hover effect combining card lift and image zoom.
  • New: Support section on the settings page with review and donation links.
  • Changed: Refreshed plugin directory tags.

4.0.1

  • New: Elementor widget with full option parity to the block. The block, Elementor widget and shortcode share one render engine.
  • Changed: Lowered the minimum PHP requirement to 7.4 for wider hosting compatibility.
  • Improved: Documentation and minor refinements.

4.0.0

  • Rewritten with a cleaner, faster architecture.
  • New: Shine hover effect.
  • New: Per-device scale control for desktop, tablet and mobile.
  • New: Two card styles: Clean Card and Minimal.
  • New: Public hook API for add-on integrations.
  • New: Settings page with global defaults, shortcode generator, performance, cache and help sections.
  • Improved: Block editor sidebar split into Settings and Styles panels.
  • Improved: Only relevant options are shown in the block sidebar.
  • Improved: All block attributes are preserved for backward compatibility with existing pages.

3.0.2

  • Previous stable release.
